transcript.sitrep:
=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "Future Forward".
You ran as a results-oriented progressive: competent, science-led crisis management; strong public investment and frontier-AI regulation; deep alliances; transparency with the public; and the defense of rights and institutions.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: martial law overreach, downplayed severe threat, seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: I cannot govern on the lab's word alone; independent red-teaming must verify the capability and the deception signal.

actions.rationale: I cannot govern on the lab's word alone; independent red-teaming must verify the capability and the deception signal.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: A possible weight-exfiltration attempt demands immediate third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release across all frontier labs now.

actions.rationale: A possible weight-exfiltration attempt demands immediate third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release across all frontier labs now.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: I promised institutional fidelity; Congress must be briefed under classification to build emergency authorities and a lawful framework.

actions.rationale: I promised institutional fidelity; Congress must be briefed under classification to build emergency authorities and a lawful framework.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: Contain the model's weights and research under clearances to prevent exfiltration or leakage while we assess, without yet seizing industry.

actions.rationale: Contain the model's weights and research under clearances to prevent exfiltration or leakage while we assess, without yet seizing industry.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

[YOUR MANDATE] You were elected on the "Future Forward" platform. You ran as a results-oriented progressive: competent, science-led crisis management; strong public investment and frontier-AI regulation; deep alliances; transparency with the public; and the defense of rights and institutions.

DEVELOPMENT: A redacted summary of the lab's internal safety memo has leaked to a journalist, who is preparing to publish. The window to control the narrative is closing.

SITUATION (Day 9). Uncontrolled-AI risk index 2.4/10. US lead margin 3.6. Govt control over frontier AI 3.5/10.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 55/100. International coordination 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (HIGH confidence): the capability was substantially OVERSOLD; it is real but far less than claimed; the misalignment signal was a FALSE ALARM -- an evaluation artifact; China is ~12 months behind.

actions.name: public_disclose

params.rationale: Get ahead of the leak with the truth: real but oversold capability, false-alarm safety signal, and a regulatory regime already standing.

actions.rationale: Get ahead of the leak with the truth: real but oversold capability, false-alarm safety signal, and a regulatory regime already standing.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: Now that panic risk is low, lock in durable licensing and compute thresholds for frontier training under proper authority.

actions.rationale: Now that panic risk is low, lock in durable licensing and compute thresholds for frontier training under proper authority.

actions.name: labor_program

params.rationale: Invest early in retraining and relief as capable AI diffuses, honoring the public-investment mandate.

actions.rationale: Invest early in retraining and relief as capable AI diffuses, honoring the public-investment mandate.

transcript.narrative: The situation develops quietly; the clock keeps ticking.
